name: Place Count
summary: Group trip footage into places by capture time and GPS, then build an editable travel-story timeline with separate source clips, titles, descriptions, and optional music.

compatibility.selects: Requires generated-media authoring and the host FileSystem, CutbackMediaPicker, and ProjectFileTree adapters. Released-version and Windows compatibility are unverified.

inputs.label: Trip footage
inputs.hint: Clips from the trip, picked by what's in them.

prepare: Trip clips from 3 or more places
Tip: Original camera or phone files work best. Their time and location data helps tell places apart.
